title: Alpine Down Puffer Jacket
description: A quilted down puffer built for cold city winters. The nylon shell is filled with 90 percent duck down and 10 percent feather for high warmth, and a removable hood adds cover in wind. A water-repellent finish sheds light rain. It has zip hand pockets and an inner chest pocket, though the generous loft makes it bulky to pack.

title: Synthetic Insulated Puffer
description: A puffer insulated with synthetic polyester fill rather than animal down, so it keeps light warmth even when damp. The polyester shell and fixed hood make it easy to throw on for commuting. A water-resistant finish shrugs off showers, and it packs into its own pocket for travel. It is a mid-warmth layer, not deep-winter armour.

title: Packable Travel Puffer
description: A slim, featherweight puffer with light polyester fill for cool autumn evenings and layering. The nylon shell is wind-resistant but has no hood, so it stays streamlined under a shell. It folds into its own hand pocket and suits city breaks and flights. This is light insulation only and offers little protection in steady rain.

title: Deep Winter Parka Puffer
description: A long-cut puffer for very cold winters, insulated with pure duck down for extreme warmth. The nylon shell and removable hood are water-resistant, and the relaxed fit leaves room for layering. Zip hand, chest and inner pockets carry essentials. It resists strong wind but is too substantial to pack and is not fully waterproof.

title: Short Down Layer Puffer
description: A short, packable down puffer with a slim fit for layering under a shell on cold days. The nylon shell holds a down and feather fill for dependable mid-warmth, while a low collar replaces a hood to keep bulk down. It packs into its own pocket for travel but offers no hood and only light wind protection.

title: Insulated Commuter Parka
description: A mid-thigh parka with synthetic insulation and a fixed hood for everyday winter commuting. The water-resistant polyester shell shields changeable weather, and zip hand pockets plus flap chest pockets hold daily essentials. The regular fit layers over knitwear. It is warm for the city but not a waterproof hard shell for heavy rain.

title: Lightweight Travel Parka
description: A long-line travel parka with a removable hood and light synthetic fill for shoulder-season trips. The water-resistant nylon shell is wind-resistant and packs down small into a stuff sack. An adjustable waist and roomy flap pockets add practicality. It is lightly insulated, so it suits cool, not freezing, weather.

title: Storm Parka
description: A fully waterproof storm parka with taped seams, a fixed hood and high wind protection for wet, exposed days. The nylon shell is waterproof rather than merely resistant, while light synthetic fill adds warmth without weight. Zip hand and inner pockets stay dry. It is warm and protective but not the most breathable for high-output activity.

title: Wool Overcoat
description: A tailored wool overcoat with notch lapels and a quilted lining for formal winter layering. The wool shell provides natural warmth without bulk, and the straight cut fits over a suit. Flap pockets and a single vent keep the silhouette sharp. It is elegant over office wear but offers only light wind protection and no weatherproofing.

title: Cashmere Blend Coat
description: A refined cashmere-blend coat with a relaxed fit and a soft, luxurious hand. Cashmere is blended with wool for warmth that feels light, and the smooth lining slides over knitwear. Welt pockets and a clean front keep it minimal for evenings and smart casual wear. It is warm and elegant but delicate and not suited to wet weather.

title: Non-Wool Tailored Coat
description: A tailored coat made entirely without wool for those avoiding animal fibers. The recycled polyester shell has a smooth, crisp drape and a quilted lining for warmth. Notch lapels and flap pockets keep it office-ready. It layers comfortably over tailoring and is easy to clean, though it is not a waterproof garment.

title: Duffle Coat
description: A casual duffle coat with a fixed hood, toggle closures and a roomy, relaxed cut for weekend layering. The wool-blend shell is warm, and patch pockets hold gloves and hats. The hood adds wind cover without a waterproof membrane. It is cosy and practical for autumn walks but heavy when wet and not packable.

title: Trench Coat
description: A classic trench coat with a water-repellent cotton shell, an adjustable belt and a removable hood for changeable spring weather. The double-breasted front and epaulettes nod to tradition, while the tailored cut stays sharp over office wear. It sheds light rain but is not waterproof, and the cotton shell offers only light warmth.

title: Linen Summer Blazer Coat
description: A lightweight linen-blend coat cut for warm evenings and smart summer events. The breathable linen and cotton shell keeps air moving, and the half-lined construction stays cool. A relaxed, unstructured fit and patch pockets give it an easy elegance. It is a warm-weather layer with no insulation and no protection from rain.

title: Stretch Office Coat
description: A tailored office coat with a touch of elastane for easy movement over a suit. The synthetic shell resists wrinkles and light showers, while the smooth lining slides on and off. Slant pockets and a clean front keep it polished for commuting. It is a moderate-warmth layer that is water-resistant, not waterproof.

title: Commuter Waterproof Rain Jacket
description: A genuinely waterproof commuter rain jacket with taped seams, a fixed hood and adjustable cuffs. The nylon shell is seam-sealed against heavy rain and folds into its own pocket for the ride home. Underarm vents and a mesh lining add breathability for cycling. It is waterproof but uninsulated, so layer underneath in cold weather.

title: Packable Cycling Rain Shell
description: A lightweight waterproof cycling shell with a drop tail, reflective details and a fixed hood that fits over a helmet. The nylon shell packs into a jersey pocket and blocks wind as well as rain. A half-length zip and elastic cuffs keep out spray. It is waterproof and packable but offers no warmth of its own.

title: City Water-Resistant Anorak
description: A pullover anorak with a water-resistant shell and a roomy front pocket for easy city errands. The fixed hood and half-zip keep light showers out, and the relaxed fit layers over a hoodie. It is water-resistant rather than waterproof, so it suits drizzle, not a downpour, and it has no insulation for cold days.

title: Hiking Waterproof Shell
description: A waterproof hiking shell with a storm hood, pit zips and articulated sleeves for moving through wet trails. The nylon shell is seam-sealed and breathable, and adjustable cuffs and hem seal out weather. Zip hand and chest pockets sit clear of a pack belt. It is a technical waterproof layer with no insulation for cold camps.

title: Budget Rain Poncho Jacket
description: An inexpensive waterproof rain jacket with a fixed hood and elastic cuffs for occasional downpours. The lightweight nylon shell is seam-taped and packs into its own pouch. It keeps you dry on short errands but has a boxy fit and little breathability, and it offers no warmth. A simple, functional budget waterproof layer.

title: Stretch Softshell Jacket
description: A four-way stretch softshell that is windproof and breathable for hiking and travel. The polyester shell has a water-resistant finish, while the brushed interior adds light warmth. Zip hand and chest pockets hold essentials, and the athletic cut moves with you. It is a versatile mid-layer but is not fully waterproof.

title: Cycling Softshell
description: A close-fitting cycling softshell with a windproof front, breathable back and reflective trims for commutes. The polyester shell sheds light rain and has a high collar instead of a hood. A slim, stretchy cut avoids flapping at speed, and a rear zip pocket holds a phone. It is weather-resistant but uninsulated.

title: Insulated Softshell Jacket
description: A softshell with a light synthetic lining for extra warmth on cool, active days. The polyester shell is windproof and water-resistant, with a regular fit that layers over a base. Zip pockets and a stand collar add comfort. It bridges a jacket and a mid-layer, though the insulation is light and it is not waterproof.

title: Hooded Softshell
description: A hooded softshell with a windproof, water-resistant shell and a brushed interior for brisk walks and errands. The fixed hood and high stretch let you move freely, while zip hand pockets keep essentials secure. The relaxed fit layers over a sweater. It resists wind and drizzle but will not keep you dry in sustained rain.

title: Trail Fleece Jacket
description: A brushed fleece mid-layer with zipped pockets and a stand collar for cool walks and alpine treks. The polyester fleece traps warm air while staying quick-drying, and the regular fit layers under a shell. It is warm and breathable as a mid-layer but provides no wind or rain protection on its own.

title: Lightweight Grid Fleece
description: A lightweight grid fleece with a breathable waffle back and a slim fit for high-output layering. The polyester fleece dries fast and moves moisture, while the low collar stays out of the way. It is a cool-weather base or mid-layer for running and hiking, with no hood and no protection against wind or rain.

title: Full-Zip Hooded Fleece
description: A full-zip fleece with a fixed hood and a relaxed fit for easy everyday warmth. The soft polyester fleece insulates on cool evenings, and zip hand pockets warm your hands. It layers over a tee or under a shell. It is cosy and casual but not windproof, and it offers no protection from rain.

title: Cotton-Blend Fleece
description: A soft cotton-blend fleece with a quarter zip and a regular fit for fireside evenings and errands. The cotton and polyester blend feels natural against the skin while drying faster than pure cotton. A stand collar and hand pockets add comfort. It is a light, casual layer with no hood and no weather protection.

title: Retro Track Jacket
description: A retro track jacket with bold color blocking and a soft inner lining, inspired by nineties sportswear. The lightweight polyester shell has a full zip and a relaxed fit, with ribbed cuffs and hem. It is a casual throw-on layer for mild days, offering little warmth and no protection from wind or rain.

title: Stretch Track Jacket
description: A modern track jacket with stretch and a slim, athletic cut for runs and warm-ups. The polyester and elastane shell moves with you and wicks moisture, while a full zip and stand collar add coverage. Zip pockets keep keys secure. It is a lightweight performance layer with no hood and no rain protection.

title: Warm Lined Track Jacket
description: A track jacket with a brushed lining for extra warmth on cool commutes and gym runs. The polyester shell is smooth outside and softly lined inside, with a regular fit and ribbed trim. Hand pockets and a full zip keep it practical. It is warmer than a basic track jacket but still not weatherproof.

title: Aerodynamic Cycling Jacket
description: A technical cycling jacket with an aerodynamic fit, a windproof front and breathable back panels. The polyester shell has reflective trims for night visibility and a low collar that stays out of the way. A rear zip pocket holds a phone. It is fast and wind-resistant but uninsulated and not a rain shell.

title: Alpine Hardshell
description: A fully waterproof alpine hardshell with a helmet-compatible hood, taped seams and a high breathability membrane. The nylon shell is built for exposed mountain weather, with a high collar and pit zips. Articulated sleeves and an athletic cut move with climbing and trekking. It is a technical waterproof layer with no insulation.

title: Insulated Ski Shell
description: A waterproof ski shell with light synthetic insulation, a removable hood and a powder skirt. The nylon shell is seam-sealed and windproof for resort days, with a high collar and zip vents. Zip hand and chest pockets carry passes and snacks. It is warm and protective but heavier than an uninsulated hardshell.

title: Trail Running Wind Shell
description: An ultralight trail-running shell with a hoodless, slim cut and a packable design. The nylon shell blocks wind and sheds light showers while staying breathable. It stuffs into its own pocket for a vest or belt. It is a minimalist layer for fast outings, not a waterproof jacket and not insulated.

title: Waxed Cotton Field Jacket
description: A heritage field jacket with a waxed cotton finish, four flap pockets and a corduroy collar. The weather-resistant cotton shell handles light rain and brambles, and the regular fit layers over knitwear. It is a durable, casual outdoor layer that softens with wear, though it is heavy and not fully waterproof.

title: Lightweight Utility Field Jacket
description: A lightweight utility field jacket with plenty of pockets for travel and everyday errands. The cotton and polyester shell is easy to pack and dries quickly, while the relaxed fit stays comfortable. Flap and cargo pockets organise the essentials. It is a casual warm-weather layer with no insulation and only light weather protection.

title: Insulated Field Parka Jacket
description: A field jacket with a warm quilted lining and a detachable hood for cool, damp days outdoors. The cotton shell is weather-resistant, and the synthetic lining adds warmth without animal fill. Four flap pockets carry tools and maps. It is a rugged, insulated layer, though heavier than a shell and not fully waterproof.

title: Classic Bomber Jacket
description: A ribbed-hem bomber with a recycled polyester shell and a light lining for transitional weather. The relaxed streetwear cut sits at the waist, with a zip front and two hand pockets. It is a simple, versatile outer layer that blocks a little wind but offers no hood and no protection from rain.

title: Warm Quilted Bomber
description: A quilted bomber with synthetic fill and a ribbed collar for extra warmth in autumn and winter. The nylon shell is smooth outside and lightly insulated inside, with a regular fit and a zip front. Hand pockets and an inner pocket keep small items close. It is warm and neat but not waterproof.

title: Suede Trim Bomber
description: A refined bomber with a leather-trimmed collar and a smooth synthetic shell for evenings out. The tailored cut is sharper than a sport bomber, and the zip front and welt pockets keep it minimal. The leather trim is a detailing accent rather than a full hide. It is a light layer with no hood and no weather protection.

title: Rigid Denim Trucker Jacket
description: A rigid denim trucker jacket with contrast stitching, chest flap pockets and a button front. The heavyweight cotton denim breaks in over time for a personal fit. It is a rugged, durable layer for cool, dry days. There is no stretch, no hood and no insulation, so it works best as an outer layer over knitwear.

title: Stretch Denim Jacket
description: A slim denim jacket with a touch of elastane for comfortable movement through the shoulders. The soft-washed cotton denim has a modern cut and simple patch pockets. It layers neatly over a tee or shirt. The stretch improves comfort, but the jacket still offers no hood, no insulation and no protection from rain.

title: Sherpa-Lined Denim Jacket
description: A denim jacket lined with a cosy synthetic fleece for chilly days. The cotton denim shell is durable, while the soft lining adds warmth through autumn. A button front and chest pockets keep the classic trucker look. It is warm and sturdy but heavy, with no hood and no water protection.

title: Classic Leather Biker Jacket
description: A full-grain leather biker jacket with an asymmetric zip, notched lapels and two zipped pockets. The genuine leather shell develops a rich patina over time, and the satin lining slides easily over a shirt. It is a structured, durable layer for evenings out, though it is heavy, needs care and offers no weather protection.

title: Suede Bomber Jacket
description: A soft suede bomber with a ribbed collar, hem and cuffs for a relaxed, refined look. The suede shell is supple and warm, with a smooth lining and simple hand pockets. It suits smart-casual evenings and cool autumn days. Suede is delicate in rain and requires careful cleaning, so it is best in dry weather.

title: Slim Leather Racer Jacket
description: A slim leather racer jacket with a stand collar and a clean, minimal front. The smooth leather shell is structured and durable, with a zip front and zipped hand pockets. It is cut close for a sharp silhouette over a tee. Leather is warm against the wind but heavy, and it offers no protection from rain.

title: Packable Windbreaker
description: A quick-dry windbreaker with a packable hood and reflective details for night runs. The lightweight nylon shell blocks wind and stows into its own pocket. A slim cut keeps it streamlined, and elastic cuffs seal out drafts. It is a thin, breathable layer for wind, not rain, and it offers no warmth of its own.

title: Water-Resistant Windbreaker
description: A water-resistant windbreaker with a fixed hood and a relaxed fit for everyday changeable weather. The polyester shell sheds light showers and blocks a steady breeze, while hand pockets keep things simple. It packs down for a bag. It is weather-resistant rather than waterproof, with no insulation for cold days.

title: Hooded Stretch Windbreaker
description: A hooded windbreaker with a touch of stretch and a regular fit for hikes and commutes. The nylon shell is windproof and lightly water-resistant, with a fixed hood that rolls away when not needed. Zip hand pockets keep small items secure. It is a breathable wind layer, not a waterproof or insulated jacket.

title: Merino Crewneck Sweater
description: A fine merino crewneck with a regular fit and ribbed cuffs for breathable, odor-resistant warmth. The merino wool shell regulates temperature and layers cleanly under a jacket. It works from the office to weekends. It is a mid-weight knit that needs gentle washing and offers no protection against wind or rain.

title: Cotton Crewneck Sweater
description: A breathable cotton crewneck with a regular fit for mild days and easy care. The pure cotton shell feels soft against the skin and washes simply. It is a light, casual layer for spring and autumn, best over a tee. There is no stretch, no hood and no weather protection, so it is a fair-weather knit.

title: Cashmere Crewneck Sweater
description: A luxurious cashmere crewneck with a regular fit and a soft, light hand. The pure cashmere shell is warm without weight and sits comfortably under a coat. It suits evenings out and smart-casual office days. Cashmere is delicate, so it needs hand washing and offers no wind or rain protection.

title: Wool Turtleneck Sweater
description: A slim wool turtleneck with a ribbed collar and cuffs for a sharp winter look. The wool shell is warm and naturally breathable, and the close cut layers under a blazer. It is an office and evening staple. Wool needs careful washing, and the knit offers no protection from wind or rain on its own.

title: Lambswool Crewneck Sweater
description: A relaxed lambswool crewneck with a cosy, textured feel for casual winter days. The lambswool shell is warm and springy, with ribbed trim at the collar and cuffs. It layers over a shirt for the weekend or a walk. It is a warm knit but needs care and offers no weather protection.

title: Cotton Linen Summer Sweater
description: A lightweight cotton and linen sweater with a relaxed fit for warm summer evenings. The breathable blend keeps air moving, and the open knit feels cool against the skin. It layers easily over a tee. This is a cool-weather-adjacent layer for summer only, with no insulation and no protection from wind or rain.

title: Alpaca Blend Sweater
description: A soft alpaca and wool blend sweater with a regular fit and a subtly brushed surface. Alpaca adds warmth and a smooth drape, while wool gives structure and resilience. It is a refined layer for cold evenings and smart casual wear. The knit is warm but delicate and offers no weather protection.

title: Wool Blend Office Sweater
description: A machine-washable wool blend sweater with a regular fit and a smooth face for office wear. Wool is blended with polyester for durability and easy care, keeping warmth without itch. It layers under a blazer or over a shirt. It is a practical mid-weight knit with no hood and no weather protection.

title: Merino Zip Neck Sweater
description: A slim merino zip-neck with stretch for active days and travel. The merino shell wicks moisture and resists odor, and the half-zip vents when you warm up. It packs small and layers under a shell. It is a performance-minded knit that is light and breathable but offers no wind or rain protection.

title: Heavyweight Cotton Sweater
description: A heavyweight cotton sweater with a relaxed fit and a chunky knit for casual winter warmth. The thick cotton shell holds its shape and feels substantial, with ribbed cuffs and hem. It works over a tee on cool days. It is a warm, easy-care layer but heavy and without any weather protection.

title: Silk Cotton Evening Sweater
description: A slim silk and cotton sweater with a fine gauge and a smooth, lustrous finish for evenings. Silk adds a soft sheen and a light, cool feel, while cotton keeps it breathable. It drapes neatly over a shirt for dinners out. It is a delicate warm-weather layer with no stretch and no weather protection.

title: Synthetic Budget Sweater
description: An affordable acrylic sweater with a regular fit and an easy-care, animal-fiber-free knit. The acrylic shell mimics the look of wool while washing and drying simply. It is a light, casual layer for cool days and layers under a jacket. It offers limited breathability and no weather protection, but it is a solid budget option.

title: Cotton Zip Hoodie
description: A full-zip hoodie in soft cotton fleece with a regular fit and a kangaroo pocket. The cotton and polyester fleece is warm inside and durable outside, with a drawcord hood and ribbed cuffs. It is an everyday layer for errands and weekends. It is cosy but not windproof and offers no protection from rain.

title: Heavyweight Pullover Hoodie
description: A heavyweight pullover hoodie in dense cotton fleece for cold, relaxed days. The thick cotton shell is brushed inside for warmth, with a relaxed fit, a drawcord hood and a kangaroo pocket. It is a sturdy everyday layer that holds its shape. It is warm and casual but not windproof and not for wet weather.

title: French Terry Hoodie
description: A light French terry hoodie with a regular fit and a loopback interior for warmer days. The cotton and polyester blend is breathable and easy to wear, with a drawcord hood and a kangaroo pocket. It layers over a tee in spring and summer evenings. It is light and comfortable but offers no weather protection.

title: Fleece Lined Hoodie
description: A fleece-lined hoodie with a regular fit and extra warmth for cold commutes. The cotton and polyester shell is lined with soft fleece, and the drawcord hood plus kangaroo pocket add coverage. It is warm enough to wear instead of a light jacket in autumn. It is cosy but not windproof and not for rain.

title: Stretch Athletic Hoodie
description: A slim athletic hoodie with four-way stretch and zip hand pockets for training. The polyester and elastane shell wicks moisture and moves with you, while the hood stays put during warm-ups. It is a performance layer for the gym and runs. It is light and quick-drying but offers no wind or rain protection.

title: Wool Blend Hoodie
description: A wool-blend hoodie with a regular fit and a refined knit for smart casual winter wear. Wool is blended with polyester for warmth and easy care, and the drawcord hood plus kangaroo pocket keep it practical. It is warmer and smarter than a cotton hoodie. It offers no weather protection and needs careful washing.

title: Merino Travel Hoodie
description: A merino hoodie with a slim fit and a packable design for travel and layering. The merino shell regulates temperature and resists odor over long trips, and the hood adds warmth when needed. A kangaroo pocket keeps hands warm. It is a light, breathable layer that offers no wind or rain protection.

title: Packable Nylon Hoodie
description: A lightweight nylon hoodie that packs into its own pocket for changeable trips. The nylon shell blocks a light breeze and dries fast, with a regular fit and a drawcord hood. Zip hand pockets hold small essentials. It is a thin, packable layer for spring and summer, not insulated and not for heavy rain.

title: Straight-Leg Rigid Jeans
description: A straight-leg five-pocket jean in rigid cotton denim that holds its shape and breaks in over time. The regular fit sits at the waist with a zip fly and a classic silhouette. It is a durable everyday pair for cool, dry days. There is no stretch, so the fit stays firm rather than forgiving.

title: Slim Stretch Jeans
description: A slim-fit jean with a touch of elastane for all-day comfort and a clean modern line. The cotton denim has a soft hand and tapers through the leg. It moves with you when sitting and cycling. It is a versatile pair for year-round wear, though the slim cut is snugger than a relaxed fit.

title: Relaxed Rigid Jeans
description: A relaxed-fit rigid jean with extra room through the seat and thigh for easy movement. The heavyweight cotton denim is durable and keeps its shape. A straight leg and five pockets keep it classic. It suits cooler days and layering, with no stretch and a roomier, more casual cut.

title: Loose Wide-Leg Jeans
description: A loose wide-leg jean in soft washed denim with a relaxed, statement silhouette. The cotton fabric is light and breathable for warm days, with a high rise and a full leg. It is a casual, easy-going pair for summer. It has no stretch and a deliberately roomy, non-tapered cut.

title: Skinny High-Stretch Jeans
description: A skinny jean with high-stretch denim for a close fit that still moves. The cotton and elastane blend recovers its shape after wear and feels comfortable through the day. A zip fly and five pockets keep it clean. It is a fitted, modern pair for year-round wear with plenty of give.

title: Tapered Stretch Jeans
description: A tapered jean with a relaxed thigh and a slim ankle, cut with medium stretch for comfort. The cotton and elastane denim keeps its shape while easing movement. A coin pocket and five-pocket layout stay classic. It is a smart-casual pair that works for weekends and laid-back offices.

title: Selvedge Straight Jeans
description: A selvedge straight jean in rigid indigo denim for denim lovers who value a crisp fade. The cotton fabric is woven on traditional looms, and the regular cut sits cleanly at the waist. Five pockets and a button fly keep it classic. It is stiff at first and best on dry, cool days.

title: Lightweight Summer Jeans
description: A lightweight summer jean in breathable cotton denim for warm weather. The regular fit and soft wash keep it comfortable on hot days, with five pockets and a zip fly. It is a cool, easy pair for holidays and weekends. It is a thin denim with no stretch and no insulation.

title: Fleece-Lined Winter Jeans
description: A winter jean with a soft fleece lining for warmth without an extra layer. The cotton denim shell looks like a regular jean, while the polyester lining traps heat on cold days. Five pockets and a straight leg keep it practical. It is warm and sturdy, though heavier than an unlined pair.

title: Stretch Straight Jeans
description: A straight jean with a whisper of stretch and a clean regular fit for easy office-casual wear. The cotton denim keeps a classic look while a little elastane adds give. Five pockets and a zip fly round it out. It is a dependable year-round pair that leans smart rather than rugged.

title: Black Skinny Jeans
description: A black skinny jean with medium stretch and a sleek, dressy look for evenings. The cotton and elastane denim holds a dark wash and hugs the leg without pinching. Five pockets and a slim ankle keep it sharp. It pairs with boots or trainers and suits a smart night out.

title: Relaxed Stretch Jeans
description: A relaxed jean with light stretch for comfort without losing its easy, casual shape. The cotton and elastane denim gives through the seat and thigh while staying neat. Five pockets and a straight leg keep it simple. It is an everyday pair for cooler days and laid-back plans.

title: Carpenter Work Jeans
description: A carpenter jean with utility loops and a hammer pocket for work and projects. The rigid cotton denim is tough, and the loose cut allows free movement. Reinforced seams and deep pockets handle tools. It is a durable, roomy pair for the workshop, with no stretch and a casual workwear look.

title: Ecru Wide-Leg Jeans
description: An ecru wide-leg jean in a pale wash with a loose, contemporary cut. The soft cotton denim is light for warm days, and the high rise gives a flattering line. Five pockets keep it classic. It is a summery, easy pair with no stretch and a deliberately roomy silhouette.

title: Performance Stretch Jeans
description: A performance jean with high stretch and moisture-wicking polyester for active commutes. The cotton, polyester and elastane blend moves freely and dries faster than pure cotton. An athletic cut and five pockets keep it functional. It is a smart, sporty pair for biking to work and all-day wear.

title: Tailored Wool Trousers
description: A tailored wool trouser with a flat front and a pressed crease for a sharp office look. The wool shell drapes cleanly and holds its shape, with a mid-rise and a straight leg. Slanted side pockets and a zip fly complete it. It is warm and refined but needs dry cleaning and has no stretch.

title: Travel Cotton Chinos
description: A lightweight cotton chino with stretch and slanted pockets for long journeys and warm days. The cotton and elastane fabric resists wrinkles and dries quickly, with a regular fit and a clean leg. It is a comfortable, easy-care trouser for travel and casual office days, though it is a warm-weather weight.

title: Linen Trousers
description: A breathable linen trouser with a relaxed leg and an elastic waist for hot days. The pure linen shell keeps air moving and feels cool against the skin. It is an easy summer pair for evenings and holidays. Linen wrinkles readily, and the trouser offers no stretch and no protection from weather.

title: Stretch Office Trousers
description: A slim office trouser with medium stretch for sitting and moving through a workday. The polyester and elastane fabric resists wrinkles and keeps a sharp crease. A clean front and slanted pockets stay professional. It is a versatile, easy-care pair for the office with a slimmer, modern cut.

title: Corduroy Trousers
description: A corduroy trouser with a regular fit and a soft, textured wale for cooler days. The cotton shell is warm and hard-wearing, with a straight leg and side pockets. It is a smart-casual pair that works for weekends and relaxed offices. It has no stretch and is heavier than a summer chino.

title: Cargo Trousers
description: A relaxed cargo trouser with large thigh pockets and a durable cotton shell for outdoor days. The straight leg and roomy fit allow easy movement, and the reinforced pockets carry tools and maps. It is a tough, casual pair for walks and projects. It has no stretch and no protection from weather.

title: Pleated Wool Trousers
description: A pleated wool trouser with a tailored cut and a single front pleat for a refined, formal line. The wool shell drapes well and sits higher at the waist, with a straight leg and side pockets. It is a dressier option for suits and occasions. It needs dry cleaning and has no stretch.

title: Stretch Jogger Trousers
description: A slim jogger-style trouser with high stretch and a drawcord waist for travel and casual days. The polyester and elastane fabric moves freely and dries quickly, with a tapered leg and zipped pockets. It looks neat enough for errands while feeling like a jogger. It is lightweight and not for cold weather.

title: Cotton Twill Chinos
description: A classic cotton twill chino with a regular fit and a clean, casual line. The pure cotton fabric is sturdy yet comfortable, with side pockets and a straight leg. It is an easy everyday trouser for spring and summer, dressed up or down. It has no stretch and is a lighter, fair-weather weight.

title: Stretch Travel Trousers
description: A technical travel trouser with high stretch and quick-dry fabric for long trips and hikes. The polyester and elastane shell resists wrinkles and moves freely, with an athletic cut and zipped security pockets. It is a versatile, low-maintenance pair that packs small. It is lightweight and not insulated.

title: Wool Blend Casual Trousers
description: A relaxed wool-blend trouser with a casual drape and easy warmth for cooler days. Wool is blended with polyester for comfort and easy care, with a straight leg and side pockets. It is a smart-casual pair that bridges the office and the weekend. It has light stretch and offers no weather protection.

title: Summer Linen Cotton Trousers
description: A light linen and cotton trouser with a regular fit for hot, easy days. The breathable blend keeps air moving and feels soft against the skin, with a straight leg and side pockets. It is a relaxed warm-weather pair for weekends and holidays. It wrinkles easily and has no stretch.

title: Slim Twill Trousers
description: A slim twill trouser with medium stretch and a tapered leg for a modern office look. The cotton and elastane fabric keeps a crisp crease while easing movement. Side pockets and a zip fly finish it cleanly. It is a versatile pair for work and evenings, with a closer cut than a classic chino.

title: Wide-Leg Polyester Trousers
description: A wide-leg trouser in fluid polyester with a loose, contemporary cut for evenings and the city. The smooth fabric drapes in soft folds, with a high waist and side pockets. It is a statement pair that moves with ease. It has no stretch and is a lightweight layer with no weather protection.

title: Commuter Stretch Trousers
description: A commuter trouser with high stretch and a durable, quick-drying blend for cycling to work. The cotton, polyester and elastane fabric moves freely and shrugs off light creases, with an athletic cut and zipped pockets. It looks neat enough for the office. It is a versatile year-round pair, unlined and breathable.

title: Womens Cropped Down Puffer
description: A cropped down puffer with a slim fit and a fixed hood for winter city wear. The nylon shell is filled with down and feather for dependable warmth, and a water-repellent finish sheds light snow. Zip hand pockets and a high collar seal out cold. The short hem is flattering but leaves the hips less covered.

title: Womens Long Down Parka Puffer
description: A long down puffer that reaches mid-calf for deep winter warmth. The nylon shell holds pure down fill and a removable hood for full coverage. A water-repellent finish and high wind protection keep the cold out, and the relaxed fit layers over knitwear. It is warm and protective but long and heavy to carry.

title: Womens Synthetic Travel Puffer
description: A packable travel puffer with synthetic fill and a slim fit for shoulder-season trips. The polyester shell is water-resistant and the synthetic insulation keeps some warmth when damp. A fixed hood and zip hand pockets add coverage, and it packs into its own pocket. It is a mid-warmth layer, not deep-winter gear.

title: Womens Hoodless Layering Puffer
description: A hoodless down puffer with a regular fit and a packable body for layering under a coat. The nylon shell holds a down and feather fill for light, even warmth, and a low stand collar replaces a hood. It packs small for travel. It offers no hood and only light wind protection, so it works best under a shell.

title: Womens Belted Down Coat Puffer
description: A belted down puffer with a shaped waist and a fixed hood for a flattering winter silhouette. The nylon shell is filled with down and feather for high warmth, and the adjustable belt defines the waist. A water-repellent finish and zip hand pockets keep it practical. It is warm and feminine but not fully waterproof.

title: Womens Insulated Travel Parka
description: A mid-length travel parka with synthetic insulation and a removable hood for cold trips. The water-resistant polyester shell is wind-resistant and has a belt to adjust the waist. Zip hand and flap pockets hold essentials. It is warm and practical for winter travel but not a waterproof hard shell for heavy rain.

title: Womens Waterproof Parka
description: A fully waterproof parka with taped seams, a fixed hood and light synthetic fill for wet, windy winters. The nylon shell is waterproof and windproof, keeping you dry on exposed commutes. Zip hand and inner pockets stay dry. It is warm and protective but less breathable during high-output activity.

title: Womens Light Packable Parka
description: A lightweight packable parka with a removable hood and slim synthetic fill for spring travel. The water-resistant nylon shell folds into its own pouch and weighs little in a bag. A drawcord waist and zip pockets add shape and function. It is a cool-weather layer, lightly insulated and not a winter parka.

title: Womens Wool Wrap Coat
description: A wool wrap coat with a tie belt and a long, elegant line for office days and evenings. The wool shell is warm and drapes well, with a smooth lining and patch pockets. The wrap front and tailored cut flatter the waist. It is refined and warm but needs dry cleaning and offers no weather protection.

title: Womens Cashmere Longline Coat
description: A longline cashmere coat with a relaxed fit and a soft, luxurious hand for cold evenings. Cashmere is blended with wool for warmth that feels light, and the smooth lining slides over dresses. Welt pockets keep the silhouette clean. It is elegant and warm but delicate, and it offers no protection from rain.

title: Womens Non-Wool Trench Coat
description: A non-wool trench coat in a smooth recycled polyester shell for those avoiding animal fibers. The water-repellent fabric sheds light rain, and the tailored cut with a belt keeps a classic line. A removable hood and flap pockets add function. It is a light-to-medium layer that is water-resistant, not waterproof.

title: Womens Belted Wool Coat
description: A belted wool coat with a removable hood and a structured, tailored cut for smart winter wear. The wool shell is warm and holds its shape, with a quilted lining for extra comfort. Flap pockets and a tie belt add polish. It is warm and refined but needs dry cleaning and has no weatherproofing.

title: Womens Linen Duster Coat
description: A long linen duster with a relaxed, open front for warm evenings and resort wear. The breathable linen shell keeps air moving, and the unstructured cut layers over dresses and tops. Patch pockets keep it simple. It is a summery layer with no insulation, no closure and no protection from wind or rain.

title: Womens Cocoon Coat
description: A cocoon coat with a rounded, relaxed silhouette and drop shoulders for a modern winter look. The wool-blend shell is warm and soft, with a smooth lining and hidden side pockets. It slips over chunky knitwear easily. It is cosy and stylish but heavy, needs dry cleaning and offers no weather protection.

title: Womens Stretch Office Coat
description: A tailored office coat with a touch of elastane for easy movement over workwear. The synthetic shell resists wrinkles and light showers, with a smooth lining and slanted pockets. The sharp cut and clean front keep it professional for commuting. It is a moderate-warmth layer that is water-resistant, not waterproof.

title: Womens Waterproof Commuter Raincoat
description: A waterproof commuter raincoat with taped seams, a fixed hood and a shaped waist. The nylon shell is seam-sealed against heavy rain and folds into its own pocket. A mesh lining and underarm vents add breathability for cycling. It is genuinely waterproof but uninsulated, so layer underneath in cold weather.

title: Womens Packable Cycling Rain Shell
description: A lightweight waterproof cycling shell with a drop tail, reflective details and a helmet-friendly hood. The nylon shell packs into a jersey pocket and blocks wind as well as rain. A half-zip and elastic cuffs keep out spray. It is waterproof and packable but offers no warmth of its own.

title: Womens Water-Resistant Anorak
description: A pullover anorak with a water-resistant shell and a roomy front pocket for easy errands. The fixed hood and half-zip keep light showers out, and the relaxed fit layers over a knit. It is water-resistant rather than waterproof, so it suits drizzle, not a downpour, and it has no insulation for cold days.

title: Womens Hiking Waterproof Shell
description: A waterproof hiking shell with a storm hood, pit zips and articulated sleeves for wet trails. The nylon shell is seam-sealed and breathable, with adjustable cuffs and hem. Zip hand and chest pockets sit clear of a pack belt. It is a technical waterproof layer with no insulation for cold camps.

title: Womens Budget Rain Poncho Jacket
description: An inexpensive waterproof rain jacket with a fixed hood and elastic cuffs for occasional downpours. The lightweight nylon shell is seam-taped and packs into its own pouch. It keeps you dry on short errands but has a boxy fit and little breathability, and it offers no warmth. A simple, functional budget layer.

title: Womens Stretch Softshell
description: A four-way stretch softshell cut with a slimmer line for women who move between trail and town. The polyester and elastane shell is windproof and breathable, with a water-resistant finish and a brushed interior for light warmth. Zip hand and chest pockets hold essentials. It is a versatile mid-layer but is not fully waterproof.

title: Womens Cycling Softshell
description: A women's cycling softshell with a windproof front, breathable back panels and reflective trims for night commutes. The polyester and elastane shell sheds light rain and sits close without flapping at speed. A rear zip pocket keeps a phone close, and the high collar replaces a hood. It is weather-resistant but uninsulated.

title: Womens Insulated Softshell
description: A women's insulated softshell with light synthetic lining for cool, active days. The polyester shell is windproof and water-resistant, with a tapered fit that layers over a base. Zip pockets and a stand collar add comfort. It bridges a jacket and a mid-layer, though the insulation is light and it is not waterproof.

title: Womens Hooded Softshell
description: A women's hooded softshell with a windproof, water-resistant shell and a brushed interior for brisk walks and errands. The fixed hood and high stretch let you move freely, while zip hand pockets keep essentials secure. The shaped cut layers over a sweater. It resists wind and drizzle but not sustained rain.

title: Womens Trail Fleece
description: A women's brushed fleece mid-layer with zipped pockets and a stand collar for cool walks and alpine treks. The polyester fleece traps warm air while staying quick-drying, and the regular fit layers under a shell. It is warm and breathable as a mid-layer but provides no wind or rain protection on its own.

title: Womens Lightweight Grid Fleece
description: A women's lightweight grid fleece with a breathable waffle back and a slim fit for high-output layering. The polyester fleece dries fast and moves moisture, while the low collar stays out of the way. It is a cool-weather base or mid-layer for running and hiking, with no hood and no protection against wind or rain.

title: Womens Hooded Fleece
description: A women's full-zip fleece with a fixed hood and a relaxed fit for easy everyday warmth. The soft polyester fleece insulates on cool evenings, and zip hand pockets warm your hands. It layers over a tee or under a shell. It is cosy and casual but not windproof, and it offers no protection from rain.

title: Womens Cotton-Blend Fleece
description: A women's soft cotton-blend fleece with a quarter zip and a regular fit for fireside evenings and errands. The cotton and polyester blend feels natural against the skin while drying faster than pure cotton. A stand collar and hand pockets add comfort. It is a light, casual layer with no hood and no weather protection.

title: Womens Retro Track Jacket
description: A women's retro track jacket with bold color blocking and a soft inner lining, inspired by nineties sportswear. The lightweight polyester shell has a full zip and a relaxed fit, with ribbed cuffs and hem. It is a casual throw-on layer for mild days, offering little warmth and no protection from wind or rain.

title: Womens Stretch Track Jacket
description: A women's modern track jacket with stretch and a slim, athletic cut for runs and warm-ups. The polyester and elastane shell moves with you and wicks moisture, while a full zip and stand collar add coverage. Zip pockets keep keys secure. It is a lightweight performance layer with no hood and no rain protection.

title: Womens Warm Lined Track Jacket
description: A women's track jacket with a brushed lining for extra warmth on cool commutes and gym runs. The polyester shell is smooth outside and softly lined inside, with a regular fit and ribbed trim. Hand pockets and a full zip keep it practical. It is warmer than a basic track jacket but still not weatherproof.

title: Womens Aerodynamic Cycling Jacket
description: A women's technical cycling jacket with an aerodynamic fit, a windproof front and breathable back panels. The polyester shell has reflective trims for night visibility and a low collar that stays out of the way. A rear zip pocket holds a phone. It is fast and wind-resistant but uninsulated and not a rain shell.

title: Womens Alpine Hardshell
description: A women's fully waterproof alpine hardshell with a helmet-compatible hood, taped seams and a high breathability membrane. The nylon shell is built for exposed mountain weather, with a high collar and pit zips. Articulated sleeves and an athletic cut move with climbing and trekking. It is a technical waterproof layer with no insulation.

title: Womens Insulated Ski Shell
description: A women's waterproof ski shell with light synthetic insulation, a removable hood and a powder skirt. The nylon shell is seam-sealed and windproof for resort days, with a high collar and zip vents. Zip hand and chest pockets carry passes and snacks. It is warm and protective but heavier than an uninsulated hardshell.

title: Womens Trail Running Wind Shell
description: A women's ultralight trail-running shell with a hoodless, slim cut and a packable design. The nylon shell blocks wind and sheds light showers while staying breathable. It stuffs into its own pocket for a vest or belt. It is a minimalist layer for fast outings, not a waterproof jacket and not insulated.

title: Womens Waxed Cotton Field Jacket
description: A women's heritage field jacket with a waxed cotton finish, four flap pockets and a corduroy collar. It is a durable, casual outdoor layer that softens with wear, though it is heavy and not fully waterproof.

title: Womens Lightweight Utility Field Jacket
description: A women's lightweight utility field jacket with plenty of pockets for travel and everyday errands. It is a casual warm-weather layer with no insulation and only light weather protection.

title: Womens Insulated Field Jacket
description: A women's field jacket with a warm quilted lining and a detachable hood for cool, damp days outdoors. It is a rugged, insulated layer, though heavier than a shell and not fully waterproof.

title: Womens Classic Bomber

title: Womens Quilted Bomber
description: A women's quilted bomber with synthetic fill and a ribbed collar for extra warmth in autumn and winter. description: A women's refined bomber with a tailored cut and a smooth synthetic shell for evenings out. The sharper silhouette and zip front with welt pockets keep it minimal and smart. title: Womens Rigid Denim Trucker Jacket
description: A women's rigid denim trucker jacket with contrast stitching, chest flap pockets and a button front. The heavyweight cotton denim breaks in over time for a personal fit. title: Womens Sherpa-Lined Denim Jacket
description: A women's denim jacket lined with a cosy synthetic fleece for chilly days. The cotton denim shell is durable, while the soft lining adds warmth through autumn. It is a structured, durable layer for evenings out, though it is heavy, needs care and offers no weather protection.

title: Womens Suede Bomber
description: A women's soft suede bomber with a ribbed collar, hem and cuffs for a relaxed, refined look. The suede shell is supple and warm, with a smooth lining and simple hand pockets. title: Womens Slim Leather Racer Jacket
description: A women's slim leather racer jacket with a stand collar and a clean, minimal front. The smooth leather shell is structured and durable, with a zip front and zipped hand pockets. It is cut close for a sharp silhouette over a tee. Leather is warm against the wind but heavy, and it offers no protection from rain.

title: Womens Packable Windbreaker
description: A women's quick-dry windbreaker with a packable hood and reflective details for night runs. The lightweight nylon shell blocks wind and stows into its own pocket. A slim cut keeps it streamlined, and elastic cuffs seal out drafts. It is a thin, breathable layer for wind, not rain, and it offers no warmth of its own.

title: Womens Water-Resistant Windbreaker
description: A women's water-resistant windbreaker with a fixed hood and a relaxed fit for everyday changeable weather. The polyester shell sheds light showers and blocks a steady breeze, while hand pockets keep things simple. It packs down for a bag. It is weather-resistant rather than waterproof, with no insulation for cold days.

title: Womens Hooded Stretch Windbreaker
description: A women's hooded windbreaker with a touch of stretch and a regular fit for hikes and commutes. The nylon shell is windproof and lightly water-resistant, with a fixed hood that rolls away when not needed. Zip hand pockets keep small items secure. It is a breathable wind layer, not a waterproof or insulated jacket.

title: Womens Merino Turtleneck
description: A slim merino turtleneck with a ribbed collar and cuffs for a refined winter look. The merino shell is warm and breathable, and the close cut layers under a blazer or dress. It works for the office and evenings. Merino needs gentle washing, and the knit offers no protection from wind or rain.

title: Womens Relaxed Cotton Crewneck
description: A relaxed cotton crewneck with a soft, easy feel for casual layering. The pure cotton shell is breathable and simple to wash, with a roomier cut over a tee or dress. It is a light, comfortable layer for spring and autumn. There is no stretch, no hood and no weather protection.

title: Womens Cashmere V-Neck
description: A slim cashmere V-neck with a soft, light hand for smart evenings and layering. The pure cashmere shell is warm without weight and sits close under a blazer. A delicate V neck flatters the collarbone. Cashmere is delicate, so it needs hand washing and offers no wind or rain protection.

title: Womens Wool Cardigan
description: A regular-fit wool cardigan with a button front and ribbed trim for easy office layering. The wool shell is warm and naturally breathable, and the open front layers over blouses. It is a versatile mid-weight knit for cool days. Wool needs care, and the cardigan offers no weather protection.

title: Womens Lambswool Turtleneck
description: A lambswool turtleneck with a regular fit and a cosy, textured feel for cold office days. The lambswool shell is warm and springy, with a folded collar and ribbed cuffs. It layers under a coat for formal wear. It is a warm knit but needs care and offers no weather protection.

title: Womens Cotton Silk Sweater
description: A slim cotton and silk sweater with a fine gauge and a soft sheen for warm evenings. Silk adds a smooth, cool feel while cotton keeps it breathable. It drapes neatly over a skirt or trousers. It is a delicate warm-weather layer with no stretch and no weather protection.

title: Womens Alpaca Crewneck
description: A relaxed alpaca crewneck with a softly brushed surface and a cosy, warm feel. Alpaca adds warmth and a smooth drape, and the relaxed cut layers over shirts. It is a refined layer for cold evenings and casual weekends. The knit is warm but delicate and offers no weather protection.

title: Womens Oversized Wool Blend Knit
description: An oversized wool-blend knit with a relaxed, boxy cut and drop shoulders for winter. Wool is blended with polyester for warmth and easy care, and the roomy fit layers over long sleeves. It is a cosy, casual statement layer. It has light stretch and offers no weather protection.

title: Womens Merino Cardigan
description: A merino cardigan with a regular fit and light stretch for travel and the office. The merino shell regulates temperature and resists odor, with a button front and patch pockets. It packs small and layers cleanly. It is a light, breathable knit that offers no wind or rain protection.

title: Womens Linen Knit Sweater
description: A breathable linen knit with a relaxed fit and an open weave for hot summer days. The pure linen shell keeps air moving and feels cool against the skin. It layers over a camisole or dress. It is a summery layer with no insulation and no protection from wind or rain.

title: Womens Acrylic Turtleneck
description: An affordable acrylic turtleneck with a regular fit and an easy-care, animal-fiber-free knit. The acrylic shell mimics the look of wool while washing and drying simply. It is a light, casual layer for cool days and layers under a jacket. It offers limited breathability and no weather protection.

title: Womens Ribbed Cotton Crewneck
description: A ribbed cotton crewneck with a slim fit and a fitted, feminine line for easy layering. The pure cotton shell is soft and breathable, with ribbed texture through the body. It sits close under a jacket or on its own. It has no stretch beyond the rib and offers no weather protection.

title: Womens Cropped Cotton Hoodie
description: A cropped cotton hoodie with a slim fit and a kangaroo pocket for casual layering. The cotton and polyester fleece is soft inside and durable outside, with a drawcord hood and ribbed hem. The shorter cut pairs with high-waist bottoms. It is cosy but not windproof and offers no protection from rain.

title: Womens Oversized Pullover Hoodie
description: An oversized pullover hoodie in soft cotton fleece for relaxed, cosy days. The cotton shell is brushed inside for warmth, with a roomy fit, a drawcord hood and a kangaroo pocket. It layers over leggings or joggers. It is warm and casual but not windproof and not for wet weather.

title: Womens Zip French Terry Hoodie
description: A zip-front French terry hoodie with a regular fit and zip hand pockets for easy layering. The cotton and polyester blend is breathable and soft, with a loopback interior for warmer days. A drawcord hood adds coverage. It is a light, comfortable layer with no weather protection.

title: Womens Fleece Lined Hoodie
description: A women's fleece-lined hoodie with a regular fit and extra warmth for cold commutes. The cotton and polyester shell is lined with soft fleece, and the drawcord hood plus kangaroo pocket add coverage. It is warm enough to wear instead of a light jacket in autumn. It is cosy but not windproof and not for rain.

title: Womens Stretch Athletic Hoodie
description: A women's slim athletic hoodie with four-way stretch and zip hand pockets for training. The polyester and elastane shell wicks moisture and moves with you, while the hood stays put during warm-ups. It is a performance layer for the gym and runs. It is light and quick-drying but offers no wind or rain protection.

title: Womens Wool Blend Hoodie
description: A women's wool-blend hoodie with a regular fit and a refined knit for smart casual winter wear. Wool is blended with polyester for warmth and easy care, and the drawcord hood plus kangaroo pocket keep it practical. It is warmer and smarter than a cotton hoodie. It offers no weather protection and needs careful washing.

title: Womens Merino Travel Hoodie
description: A women's merino hoodie with a slim fit and a packable design for travel and layering. The merino shell regulates temperature and resists odor over long trips, and the hood adds warmth when needed. A kangaroo pocket keeps hands warm. It is a light, breathable layer that offers no wind or rain protection.

title: Womens Packable Nylon Hoodie
description: A women's lightweight nylon hoodie that packs into its own pocket for changeable trips. The nylon shell blocks a light breeze and dries fast, with a regular fit and a drawcord hood. Zip hand pockets hold small essentials. It is a thin, packable layer for spring and summer, not insulated and not for heavy rain.

title: Womens High-Rise Straight Jeans
description: A high-rise straight jean in rigid cotton denim with a flattering, classic cut. The regular fit sits at the natural waist with a button fly and a straight leg. A coin pocket joins the five-pocket layout. It is a durable everyday pair for cool, dry days, with no stretch and a firm, structured feel.

title: Womens High-Rise Skinny Jeans
description: A high-rise skinny jean with medium stretch and a close, sculpted fit. The cotton and elastane denim hugs the leg and recovers its shape after wear. A zip fly and five pockets keep it clean. It is a versatile pair for year-round wear, with a fitted cut that moves with you.

title: Womens Mom Jeans
description: A relaxed mom jean with a high waist and a tapered, slightly roomy leg. The rigid cotton denim holds its shape, with a button fly and five pockets. It is an easy, vintage-inspired pair for casual days. There is no stretch and no insulation, so it works best in mild weather.

title: Womens Wide-Leg Jeans
description: A wide-leg jean in soft washed denim with a high waist and a full, flowing leg. The cotton fabric is light and breathable for warm days, with five pockets and a zip fly. It is a relaxed, statement pair for summer. It has no stretch and a deliberately roomy, non-tapered cut.

title: Womens Slim Stretch Jeans
description: A women's slim-fit jean with light stretch and a clean modern line for all-day comfort. The cotton and elastane denim has a soft hand and tapers through the leg. description: A loose boyfriend jean with a relaxed, borrowed-from-the-boys fit and a low rise. The rigid cotton denim is soft and broken-in, with a straight leg and five pockets. It is a casual, easy pair for cooler days and layering. There is no stretch and no insulation.

title: Womens Cropped Straight Jeans
description: A women's cropped straight jean in lightweight cotton denim for warm weather. The regular fit ends above the ankle, with five pockets and a zip fly. It is a cool, easy pair for holidays and weekends. It is a thin denim with no stretch and no insulation, best in mild weather.

title: Womens Black Skinny Jeans
description: A women's black skinny jean with medium stretch and a sleek, dressy look for evenings. The cotton and elastane denim holds a dark wash and hugs the leg without pinching. Five pockets and a slim ankle keep it sharp. It pairs with boots or heels and suits a smart night out.

title: Womens High-Rise Wide Jeans
description: A high-rise wide jean in soft cotton denim with a dramatic, full leg. The regular waist and loose cut create a flattering, elongated line. Five pockets keep it classic. It is a statement pair for spring and autumn, with no stretch and no insulation, so it layers best over tights.

title: Womens Stretch Straight Jeans
description: A women's straight jean with a whisper of stretch and a clean regular fit for easy office-casual wear. The cotton denim keeps a classic look while a little elastane adds give. title: Womens Fleece-Lined Winter Jeans
description: A women's winter jean with a soft fleece lining for warmth without an extra layer. The cotton denim shell looks like a regular jean, while the polyester lining traps heat on cold days. title: Womens Relaxed Stretch Jeans
description: A women's relaxed jean with light stretch for comfort without losing its easy, casual shape. The cotton and elastane denim gives through the seat and thigh while staying neat. Five pockets and a straight leg keep it simple. It is an everyday pair for cooler days and laid-back plans.

title: Womens Ecru Wide-Leg Jeans
description: A women's ecru wide-leg jean in a pale wash with a loose, contemporary cut. The soft cotton denim is light for warm days, and the high rise gives a flattering line. Five pockets keep it classic. It is a summery, easy pair with no stretch and a deliberately roomy silhouette.

description: A women's performance jean with high stretch and moisture-wicking polyester for active commutes. The cotton, polyester and elastane blend moves freely and dries faster than pure cotton. description: A women's tailored wool trouser with a flat front and a pressed crease for a sharp office look. The wool shell drapes cleanly and holds its shape, with a high waist and a straight leg. title: Womens Travel Stretch Chinos
description: A women's lightweight cotton chino with stretch and slanted pockets for long journeys and warm days. It is a comfortable, easy-care trouser for travel and casual office days, though it is a warm-weather weight.

title: Womens Wide-Leg Linen Trousers
description: A women's wide-leg linen trouser with a relaxed fit and an elastic waist for hot days. The pure linen shell keeps air moving and feels cool against the skin. The full leg drapes softly. description: A women's slim office trouser with medium stretch for sitting and moving through a workday. The polyester and elastane fabric resists wrinkles and keeps a sharp crease. description: A women's corduroy trouser with a regular fit and a soft, textured wale for cooler days. The cotton shell is warm and hard-wearing, with a straight leg and side pockets. description: A women's relaxed cargo trouser with large thigh pockets and a durable cotton shell for outdoor days.
